profile.name: Md Mahfuzul Islam
profile.identityLine: Data Engineer and EEE graduate building healthcare data infrastructure, applied AI workflows, and engineering simulation systems.
profile.shortIntro: I design and deliver production-ready data pipelines and AI-enabled software for clinical analytics and technical platforms, with strong focus on data integrity, security, and measurable outcomes.

featuredProjects.title: Healthcare Data Integration & Analytics Pipeline
featuredProjects.summary: Large-scale clinical data processing pipeline for Ibrahim Cardiac Hospital & Research Institute, turning complex records into analysis-ready datasets.
featuredProjects.detail: Designed and implemented Python workflows to clean, validate, and harmonize patient records, laboratory data, and clinical metadata across multiple sources, with strong consistency checks for downstream analytics and research.
featuredProjects.impact: Enabled reliable analysis-ready healthcare datasets for research and reporting workflows.
contributions: Designed Python-based healthcare data processing pipelines
Harmonized large clinical datasets from multiple sources
Resolved duplicate records, ID mismatches, and irregular date formats
Integrated patient and laboratory data into a unified analytical dataset
Performed quality validation and standardization for research usage

featuredProjects.title: Electrical Engineering RAG Bot
featuredProjects.summary: Local-first EE chatbot with retrieval-augmented generation over textbooks, bilingual support (English/Bengali), source citations, and step-by-step answers.
featuredProjects.detail: Built as a practical AI toolchain for technical learning with retrieval over engineering sources, controllable reasoning detail, and configurable local/remote model support.
featuredProjects.impact: Demonstrates full-stack AI system design for engineering education.

featuredProjects.title: EV Powertrain Simulation
featuredProjects.summary: MATLAB/Simulink modeling of EV powertrain performance with variable battery sizing and PID control.
featuredProjects.detail: Time-domain simulation explored acceleration, efficiency, and range tradeoffs to identify practical battery configuration strategies.

featuredProjects.title: Breast Cancer Survival Prediction
featuredProjects.summary: SEER-based survival analysis using Kaplan-Meier, Cox Proportional Hazard, and Random Survival Forest models.
featuredProjects.detail: Applied statistical and machine learning survival modeling to support risk-aware clinical decision support analysis.

featuredProjects.title: Advanced Controller Design and Optimization (PMSM FOC)
featuredProjects.summary: Technical assessment project on PI current-controller redesign for PMSM field-oriented control with improved settling and robustness.
featuredProjects.detail: Used series PI controller design, comparative tuning analysis, and simulation-based validation of dynamic response under parameter variations.
featuredProjects.impact: Showcases analytical controller design workflow from problem framing to quantitative validation.

projects.title: Anomaly Detection Using Gaussian Model
projects.summary: Server anomaly detection with Gaussian and multivariate density modeling, threshold tuning, and F1-guided evaluation.
projects.detail: Built a probabilistic anomaly-detection workflow for server metrics using univariate and multivariate Gaussian models, threshold selection via F1 optimization, and false-positive control analysis for more reliable incident flagging.

projects.title: ECG Signal Denoising with Wiener Filtering
projects.summary: Biomedical signal enhancement using synchronous averaging, cross-correlation QRS detection, and Wiener filtering.
projects.detail: Implemented an ECG-cleaning pipeline combining synchronous averaging, QRS detection through cross-correlation, and Wiener filtering to improve signal quality for downstream waveform interpretation.

projects.title: Image Thresholding for Background Removal
projects.summary: Image preprocessing workflow for white/near-white background removal through threshold-based segmentation.
projects.detail: Developed a threshold-based RGB preprocessing workflow to isolate foreground objects from white and near-white backgrounds, with parameter tuning for improved edge preservation and segmentation stability.

projects.title: Bluetooth Interfacing with 8051
projects.summary: Embedded wireless command-control system with HC-05 and 8051 for LED/LCD/relay/buzzer operations.
projects.detail: Engineered an embedded Bluetooth command system around 8051 + HC-05 to control LCD, LEDs, relay modules, and buzzer states through serial protocols, including command handling and basic security logic.

projects.title: Two-Area Power System MATLAB Simulink
projects.summary: Load-frequency and tie-line dynamic analysis for an interconnected two-area power system.
projects.detail: Modeled a two-area interconnected power system in Simulink to analyze load-frequency control behavior, tie-line power deviations, and system response under load disturbances.

projects.title: Cardiac EDA Processing
projects.summary: Private healthcare ETL pipeline for extracting Oracle exports and multi-sheet labs, then consolidating into curated clinical data assets.
projects.detail: Designed a private healthcare ETL workflow that ingests Oracle exports and multi-sheet lab reports, standardizes identifiers and timelines, and outputs curated patient-level datasets for reliable analysis.

projects.title: Coronary Angiogram Dataset Cleaning
projects.summary: Private workflow for cleaning and standardizing coronary angiogram data including severity classification and derived features.
projects.detail: Implemented rule-based cleaning and harmonization for coronary angiogram records, including severity normalization, derived feature generation, and quality checks to reduce analytical noise.

projects.title: Mawlana Nurul Amin MP Web Application
projects.summary: Bilingual (Bangla + English) public-service web platform with citizen request workflows, donation modules, and admin-managed content operations.
projects.detail: Implemented as a secure Next.js application with role-based admin workflows, form-driven content management, request tracking, and media/document publishing for public communication.

projects.title: Md Mahfuzul Islam Portfolio (Admin-Managed)
projects.summary: Secure portfolio platform with authenticated admin CMS, schema-validated content updates, and protected management routes.
projects.detail: Built with server-side validation, signed session cookies, rate-limited authentication, and local JSON persistence to support controlled website-wide content management.

technicalFocus.title: Secure Admin-Managed Platforms
technicalFocus.detail: Designing bilingual, admin-controlled Next.js platforms with role-based access, protected routes, validated content workflows, and operational dashboards.

technicalFocus.title: Healthcare Data Engineering
technicalFocus.detail: Building high-integrity ETL and validation pipelines that harmonize clinical records into analysis-ready datasets for research and decision support.

technicalFocus.title: Applied AI and Retrieval Systems
technicalFocus.detail: Developing practical AI workflows including RAG, citation-grounded responses, and domain-focused LLM integrations for technical users.

technicalFocus.title: Simulation and Control Analysis
technicalFocus.detail: Using MATLAB/Simulink and control methods to evaluate stability, performance tradeoffs, and implementation choices in engineering systems.

highlights: Built healthcare data pipelines integrating ~70k patient records and 1M+ laboratory entries for reliable analytics delivery.
Published survival-analysis research at ICECET 2023 (South Africa) using SEER-based clinical outcomes data.
Led cross-functional delivery across healthcare data engineering, applied AI workflows, and software implementation.
Co-founded AZM Labs to build practical, deployment-ready AI and data systems.
aboutSummary: I am a Data Engineer at Enact Business Solutions with an Electrical and Electronic Engineering foundation.
I build healthcare data infrastructure and applied AI workflows that are reliable, validated, and delivery-ready.
My work combines data engineering, model-driven analysis, and secure platform implementation.
As Co-Founder and Software Engineer at AZM Labs, I lead execution of practical AI/data products from architecture to delivery.
workingPhilosophy: Establish data integrity before model decisions.
Translate research ideas into deployable, maintainable systems.
Design for traceability, security, and operational reliability.
Prioritize measurable outcomes over feature noise.

points: Built Python-based pipelines for multi-source clinical datasets, including patient, lab, and outcome records.
Standardized identifiers and timelines across sources to produce analysis-ready integrated datasets.
Implemented quality controls for missing values, duplicates, and temporal consistency before downstream analytics.

experience.org: AIMS Lab, IRIIC, United International University
points: Contributed to Jotno.AI and Susastho.AI across NLP-driven screening and healthcare guidance workflows.
Applied machine learning and NLP techniques for symptom triage, risk-aware assessment, and model evaluation.
Worked with cross-functional teams to translate research workflows into deployable technical systems.
Driving technical strategy and execution for practical AI and data-centric software systems.
Leading delivery planning, technical direction, and operational priorities across client and internal platforms.
Built secure, admin-managed web platforms with role-based workflows and validated content pipelines.
Delivered Next.js systems spanning content management, citizen workflows, and operational dashboards.

researchThemes: Healthcare data integration and reliable analytical infrastructure
Survival modeling and interpretable clinical ML
Signal and system-level analysis for biomedical and engineering use-cases
Controller design and performance optimization in electrical drives
Retrieval-augmented AI tools for technical learning and decision support
achievementItems: OIC partial scholarship recipient for academic excellence at IUT.
Champion, 10th Mathematical Olympiad (Higher Secondary Group, Dinajpur).
Director of Operations, Esonance 2023 (major university tech festival).
